name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt a 4px focus ring at 7:1 contrast by default for all interactive elements. This ensures keyboard users see clear, high-contrast focus indicators even on mobile or low-vision screens. The trade-off is slightly larger ring size, but it improves usability without clutter.

name: Reader
text: Risk: 3px at 4.5:1 fails when users toggle *both* reduced motion *and* high contrast—users see a faint ring that disappears against backgrounds. Alternative: 2px ring at 4.5:1 with a 1px solid border at 7:1. Settle with a live test: measure visibility for 5 users toggling both modes on 3 devices.
